title: Strategy Router Decision v1 (C-112 Phase 1)
description: Advisory-only output of scripts/strategy_router.py. state preserves HOLD/UNKNOWN/NO_ACTION evidence status even while the Phase 1 live-influence feature flag is OFF; there is no BUY/SHORT/CANDIDATE state at the router level. This never influences an existing formal signal or execution path.

horizon.description: A HORIZON_SUPERVISORS key (e.g. SCALP), or null for a symbol-level decision.

supervisor_directions.description: Read-only passthrough of each reporting supervisor's own direction, for display only.

feature_flag_enabled.description: Phase 1: always false. Flipping this on is a later, separate gate and does not itself authorize execution.
